additional_info.body: The station indicates a module error 2102312VGQLUN5000160SA002200000200FW. The problem is currently with FastShutDown F:0, but until just now the problem in SCB is F:17 - that is, internal communication error. The plugs (CAN/ FS) were corrected; however, the problem persists - please support what we can additionally check.
